icons.usage: Use strictly Lucide icons (e.g., Settings, Plus, Printer, Edit2, Trash2, ArrowLeft, RefreshCw, ChevronDown). No emojis.

design_instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENTATION CONTEXT: You are building a UI to demonstrate the transformation from a Mobile App to a Web POS. The left side should feature a mock 'Phone' container illustrating the 3 reference mobile screens. The right side is the newly designed Web Settings Panel.
STRICT COLOR PALETTE: You MUST only use the exact hex codes provided in the colors object. Primary actions must use the primary orange (#F26B33). Success states/toggles use green (#329937).

LEFT COLUMN (MOBILE REF): Build a mock mobile frame using 'border-[12px] border-gray-900 rounded-[2.5rem] overflow-y-auto h-[800px] w-full max-w-[360px] mx-auto bg-gray-50'. Inside, create 3 visually distinct sections simulating 'Screen 1', 'Screen 2', and 'Screen 3' as described in the problem statement.
RIGHT COLUMN (WEB POS): Build the new settings panel. It should look like a slide-over or compact settings panel.

WEB LAYOUT - TOP SECTION: A Header 'Local Printer Setup' followed by a 'Basic Configuration' card (using the specified 1px border card style) with the 'Printing Mode' selector. Use a segmented pill tab (from the tab component styles) or a clean inline dropdown for Fixed / Waiter / Station.
WEB LAYOUT - MIDDLE SECTION: A dense data table representing the Printer List. Columns: Area Name, Printer Type, Actions (Edit/Trash).

WEB LAYOUT - INLINE FORM: Instead of opening a new page or modal, when 'Edit' or 'Add' is clicked, expand an inline form card directly below the table (or replacing the row/table). The form MUST use a dense 2-column grid (`grid-cols-2`) to fit the 10 fields compactly.

FORM FIELDS: Ensure all 10 fields from the problem statement are present: Printer For, Printer Type, Printer Name, IP/MAC, WiFi Printer IP, Paper Roll Size, Vendor ID, Product ID, Default Stage, Auto Serve, Station GST. Map them to appropriate input types (Select, Text, Switch).
TESTING: Every single interactive element, form field, and tab MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='printer-mode-select', data-testid='edit-printer-btn').

accessibility.contrast: Text contrast complies with WCAG AA. Backgrounds and text pairs are optimized.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must use focus-visible states, particularly focusing with the orange tint `focus:ring-[#F26B33]/20`.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply `transition: all` globally. Apply targeted transitions.
Never center-align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Keep natural left-alignment.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals; always use solid white or F7F7F7.
Ensure the layout is completely responsive. On smaller screens, the side-by-side layout should stack (Mobile Mockup top, Web Design bottom).
Add functional state management in React so the 'Edit Printer' form toggles visibility when the Edit button or Add (+) is clicked.
